description: Aspicio turns DXF CAD drawings into things ChatGPT can work with: structured facts (units, bounds, layers with the colors actually drawn, entity counts, and the drawing's text content), rendered PNG images, and an interactive in-chat viewer with pan, zoom, layer toggles, and fullscreen. Point it at a drawing URL or paste DXF text to read title blocks and dimension values, check layer structure, and visually inspect floor plans, die-cut layouts, and mechanical parts without leaving the conversation.

defaultPrompt: What layers are in this drawing, and what size is it? http://bit.ly/3Tdg2ei
Let me explore this floor plan interactively: http://bit.ly/3Tdg2ei
Read me the text and dimension values in this DXF: http://bit.ly/3Tdg2ei
